name: @slayzone/eslint-ts-parser
description: The parser ESLint uses for TS/TSX: Babel 8's @babel/eslint-parser, with the TS/TSX parser plugins chosen per file extension. Its own package so its Babel 8 stays apart from the Babel 7 the React Compiler runs on (babel-plugin-react-compiler is built on Babel 7). No rule needs type information, so no `typescript` package is involved.
